title: ci_fix_result — review-merge CI-fix agent's report (task 10)
description: The CI-fix agent's output (docs/stage-io, task 10). The gate's shape checks are outcome enum + scope literal ci_only; reason is required when outcome is cannot_fix and the gate publishes it. `risk` is not part of this contract. _io is stamped by the server.

files.description: Every entry must already appear in the reviewed changed-files list when outcome is fixed.

summary.description: What was failing, what changed, and why that makes the check pass; published verbatim.

reason.description: Required when outcome is cannot_fix: what a human must decide or do, published verbatim.
